import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a correlation matrix for numerical columns
corr_matrix = df[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']].corr()

# Create a heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap='coolwarm', cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation Coefficient'})
plt.title('Correlation Matrix of Sleep Health Metrics')
plt.xlabel('Metrics')
plt.ylabel('Metrics')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a correlation matrix for numerical columns
corr_matrix = df[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']].corr()

# Create a heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap='coolwarm', cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation Coefficient'})
plt.title('Correlation Matrix of Sleep Health Metrics')
plt.xlabel('Metrics')
plt.ylabel('Metrics')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
